leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the box-sizing: border-box property to HTML elements
Configure a CSS reset to use border-box across all elements
Manipulate element dimensions while maintaining consistent total size
Construct layouts where padding and borders don't affect overall width calculations
Update existing CSS rules to incorporate border-box behavior
Integrate border-box with other CSS properties for predictable layouts
Control element sizing behavior by switching between content-box and border-box
